Map of dry-season canopy greenness and dry grown-in segments

Source: R/plot.R
plot_canopy_dryness.Rd

Scored Landsat pixels are drawn at their 30 m footprint on a sequential greenness ramp (dry ochre to deep olive) with the dry_canopy cut marked on the key; pixels the screen did not score (too little canopy, too little LiDAR coverage, too few clear looks) are grey. Segments are coloured by the combined screen under the chosen conductor bound.

Usage

plot_canopy_dryness(dryness, bound = c("hi", "lo"), title = NULL, file = NULL)

Arguments

dryness

Output of canopy_dryness().

bound

"hi" (optimistic conductor, the default) or "lo" (pessimistic): which grow-in tier "grown in" refers to.

title

Plot title; NULL states how many grown-in segments have dry canopy.

file

Output PNG path, or NULL.
